metadata.name: Odyssey of the Dragonlords — pełna mapa relacji
metadata.notes: Mapa oparta na Campaign Book (Appendix D: Dramatis Personae oraz rozdziały 1–12) i osobno oznaczonych wpisach Kroniki kampanii. Relacje źródłowe są opisane w notatkach krawędzi. Wpisy z Kroniki niepotwierdzone w podręczniku są oznaczone jako wymagające potwierdzenia przy stole.

entities.name: Thylea
entities.notes: Elder goddess and Mother of All; created the land as a refuge for nature and fey. Takes the form of a colossal world-tree at the heart of the sacred forest.

entities.name: Kentimane
entities.notes: Husband and guardian of Thylea; personification of destructive natural forces. His sleeping body manifests as colossal stone arms across the land.

entities.name: Sydon
entities.notes: Twin Titan; Lord of Storms and Oceans. Seeks dominion over Thylea and demands worship and sacrifice.

entities.name: Lutheria
entities.notes: Twin Titan; Lady of Dreams and Death. Sister-wife of Sydon; seeks souls and the transformation of mortals into beasts.

entities.name: Mytros
entities.notes: Goddess of Dawn, Silver Queen; ancient silver dragon Balmytria. Ascended after sacrificing herself to protect Mytros and forge the Oath of Peace.

entities.name: Volkan
entities.notes: God of Forges; ancient bronze dragon and husband of Balmytria. Father of Kyrah, Pythor, Vallus and Narsus.

entities.name: Pythor
entities.notes: God of Battle; king of Estoria. Ancient bronze dragon; father of Hexia and other demigod offspring.

entities.name: Kyrah
entities.notes: Goddess of Music and Poetry; trickster and court poet of Mytros. Formerly a bronze dragon, oathsworn mount of Estor Arkelander.

entities.name: Vallus
entities.notes: Goddess of Wisdom; queen of Mytros and wife of King Acastus. Daughter of Mytros and Volkan.

entities.name: Narsus
entities.notes: Forgotten God of Beauty; one of the original bronze dragons in Volkan and Balmytria's family; oathsworn of Jasena Ventrak.

entities.name: Helios
entities.notes: Forgotten God of the Sun; associated with the Garden of Helios.

entities.name: Król Acastus
entities.notes: King of Mytros, last surviving Arkelander descendant; married to Vallus. Ambitious and insecure; secretly aided by Lutheria and allied with the Order of Sydon.

entities.name: Estor Arkelander
entities.notes: Dragonlord and captain of the ghost ship Ultros; oathsworn of Kyrah. Cursed by Lutheria to roam the oceans as a ghost; haunts Acastus's dreams.

entities.name: Adonis Neurdagon
entities.notes: Dragonlord, oathsworn of Pythor; lover and partner of Aesop. Rescued Aesop and founded the Neurdagon dynasty; killed in the final stand of the Dragonlords.

entities.name: Aesop
entities.notes: Elven priest and Keeper of the Dragon Shrine in Estoria; lover of Adonis Neurdagon and advocate for restoring the Dragonlords.

entities.name: Wieszczka Versi
entities.notes: Water nymph, daughter of Sydon and Delphea. Prophecies the Dragonlords and Five Gods; brokered the meeting that led to the Oath of Peace.

entities.name: Delphea
entities.notes: Naiad; mother of Versi and former partner of Sydon.

entities.name: Darien
entities.notes: Rightful heir to the Amazon throne on Themis; daughter of Queen Thesilea. Imprisoned by the medusae who usurped her family.

entities.name: Królowa Thesilea
entities.notes: Amazon queen of Themis and mother of Darien; one of the three matriarchs murdered by usurping medusae.

entities.name: Królowa Helen
entities.notes: Ruler of Aresia; sovereign of the rival kingdom to Mytros.

entities.name: Król Kruul
entities.notes: King of the centaurs; encountered during the heroes' labors.

entities.name: Anora
entities.notes: A named figure in the campaign's recorded sessions; details of her role in the sourcebook/campaign need table-specific confirmation.

entities.name: Xander Huorath
entities.notes: Greatest of the Dragonlords; Balmytria's oathsworn rider. His tomb lies in the Necropolis at Telamok.

entities.name: Taran Neurdagon
entities.notes: Descendant of Adonis Neurdagon; member of the surviving Neurdagon dynasty in Mytros.

entities.name: Gaius
entities.notes: Named NPC in the Dramatis Personae; associated with the campaign's mortal cast. Details should be confirmed against the relevant encounter.

entities.name: Loreus
entities.notes: Named NPC in the Dramatis Personae; details and campaign role recorded in the sourcebook.

entities.name: Pholon

entities.name: Steros
entities.notes: Jancan cyclops artificer from Praxys; skilled craftsman and wielder of a magic monocle. His father was captured by Amazons on Themis.

entities.name: Chondrus
entities.notes: Tiefling NPC listed in the Dramatis Personae.

entities.name: Hexia
entities.notes: Dragon associated with Pythor; his former wife and mother of his children.

entities.name: Icarus
entities.notes: Adult silver dragon mount of King Acastus; aged unnaturally quickly from an egg.

entities.name: Rizon Phobas
entities.notes: Dragonlord and oathsworn of Volkan; chronicler/voice quoted in the account of the First War.

entities.name: Jasena Ventrak
entities.notes: Dragonlord and oathsworn of Narsus.

entities.name: Zakon Smoczych Władców

entities.name: Centaury z Thylei
entities.notes: Native tribes of the steppes; fought the Dragonlords in the First War; fiercely loyal to native gods.

entities.name: Amazonki z Themis
entities.notes: Warrior society of Themis; their matriarchal throne was usurped by medusae.

entities.name: Zakon Sydona
entities.notes: Zealous order that serves Sydon, influences Mytros politics and seeks to enforce his worship.

entities.name: Kult Węża
